'''Hylo Visz's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who lived on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] with her [[Hylo Visz's father|husband]] and [[Hylo Visz|daughter]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] launched an [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|assault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]], her husband was [[Death/Legends|killed]] and she and Hylo were forced to flee the planet alongside hundreds of other refugees. Despite escaping the battle alive, the Mirialan women came down with a severe illness during their flight from the conflict. While their refugee [[Transport/Legends|transport]] stopped over on the "Smuggler's [[Moon/Legends|Moon]]" of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Hylo's mother died, leaving the young Mirialan an orphan. Hylo Visz went on to become a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-renowned [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Just before she contracted her illness, she stained her favorite robes. This was an event that led to Hylo's belief in the [[Invisible Law of the Universe]].
